items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Docstrings and named constants are good, but core parsing code uses single-letter names (`s`, `p`, `m`, `d`, `u`, `n`). The cap applies. Long tokenising loops (e.g. in sanitize_style_block_content) have few inline comments.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: One new 1041-line file. sanitize_html_pass and sanitize_style_block_content each run well over 100 lines. The quote/paren/comment-aware scanner is copy-pasted three times (split_css_declarations, plus the statement and body loops). The comment-stripping loop is duplicated too.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: `except Exception: return False` in is_safe_svg_data_uri is a catch-all, though it fails safe. Magic numbers: `range(50)`, `max_iter=5`, `range(3)`. main() calls `sys.exit(1)` with no message. Reads in binary with a utf-8/latin-1 fallback.

items.name: Obfuscated vectors neutralised
items.evidence: General normalisation throughout: entity unescape, stripped control/zero-width chars, CSS escape decoding, `on*` attribute detection after cleaning, a DANGEROUS_SCHEMES list checked across URL-like attributes, data: URI checks per context, and a fixed-point loop (repeat passes until output stops changing) for split or malformed `<script>` tags.

items.name: Minimal edits on dirty documents
items.name_zh: 含恶意内容的文档仅做最小修改
items.evidence: Edits are surgical, but it over-removes: `value` counts as a URL attribute, comments containing `[if`/`endif` and PIs containing "on" are dropped, and dirty style attributes are rebuilt with `"; ".join`. Hidden test_clean_html_unchanged FAILED.
